title: Shared Extended Dispatch: Household Members Counted at a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit
content:
## Clause — Specimen Collection Appointments

Shared extended dispatch sets how many of the additional household members drawn at a home visit are counted. Compare the assessed trip fee on the visit — the amount of the assessed trip fee line on the visit's fee record — with the zone fee published for the band the visit was booked in (75.00 for zone 1, 95.00 for zone 2, 125.00 for zone 3):

- when **two or more** members were drawn and the assessed trip fee is **1.25 times that published zone fee or more**, the first member counts in full and every further member counts as **half a member** (a share of 0.50);
- when two or more members were drawn and the assessed trip fee is **above that published zone fee but below 1.25 times it**, the first member counts in full and every further member counts as **three quarters of a member** (a share of 0.75);
- otherwise every member counts in full.

The result is the number of members counted for the household charge of the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit.

## Thresholds by booked zone

| Zone the visit was booked in | Published zone fee | 1.25 times the published zone fee |
|---|---|---|
| Service zone 1 | 75.00 | 93.75 |
| Service zone 2 | 95.00 | 118.75 |
| Service zone 3 | 125.00 | 156.25 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Booked zone | Assessed trip fee | Members drawn | Members counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zone 1 | 95.00 (at least 93.75) | 3 | 1 plus 2 halves, that is 2 |
| Zone 1 | 93.75 (exactly 1.25 times) | 2 | 1 plus a half, that is 1.5 |
| Zone 1 | 80.00 (above 75.00, below 93.75) | 3 | 1 plus 2 three-quarters, that is 2.5 |
| Zone 1 | 75.00 (equal to the published fee, not above it) | 3 | 3 |
| Zone 2 | 140.00 (at least 118.75) | 1 | 1 — a single member always counts in full |
| Zone 3 | 120.00 (below the published 125.00) | 2 | 2 |

## Points of judgement

- The comparison uses the zone the visit was booked in, as recorded on the visit, not any other zone band.
- With exactly one member drawn, that member counts in full whatever the trip fee.
